spec.name: sprint42_taker_imbalance_cont_btceth
spec.hypothesis: Extreme 1m-aggregated taker buy/sell imbalance (z-score vs trailing 24h) predicts same-direction drift over the next 30 minutes in BTC/ETH, exceeding round-trip T1 costs.
spec.power_argument: Cap 6 entries/day/symbol across 2 symbols gives >=300 validation trades. Assumed per-trade sd is ~40bps, so SE is ~2.3bps at n=300 and min detectable net edge is ~7bps at t>=3. FAIL if mean_net<=0 or t<3. Precondition: dry-run must show entries>0 on the training window, otherwise report LOADER_FAILURE, not FAIL.

errors: closed-door terms ['taker_imbalance']: registry says these families are dead at daily frequency; a NEW mechanism must be argued explicitly
